title: Subject collection
description: Things that can be classified. A subject is identified by a URN of the form <namespace>:<path>, resolvable without knowing what wrote it. One file holds many subjects because the alternative is one file per function, which is a directory nobody can read. The file's front matter is this document.

namespace.description: Namespace every subject in this file belongs to. The set of namespaces is DATA, not an enum in code: it is destined to become the 'namespace' facet. See NAMING.md.

generated_by.description: What produced this file, so a reader can tell asserted data from derived data.

prompt.description: Ledger entry that produced this file.

id.description: The URN. 'psmodule:PSModuleGraph/function/Get-PSModuleClass' and 'facet:networking' are both valid; the second is how a facet becomes classifiable by another facet.

name.description: Human-readable label. Not an identifier and not required to be unique.

parent.description: Containing subject, when there is one. A function's parent is its module.

source.description: Where the subject was observed. A repository-relative path, never absolute: an absolute path leaks a username into a file meant to travel.

aliases.description: Former identifiers that still resolve. A rename never deletes.
